title: Auto-Derive Playgrounds From Examples
description: Eliminate hand-written core/playground.ts across all 24 playground apps by introducing a generic config-driven playground factory in framework-playground-core, and split fixture vs example concepts: internal test fixtures vs user-facing examples that auto-populate the navbar dropdown.
summary: Fixed runtime boot failures for playgrounds after the example/playground migration. Root causes were merge corruption: note used `this.id` in arrow fn createRuntime, writer missing imports, gis MapPlayController constructor typo, puzzle-3d missing PUZZLE_3D_PLAY_KINDS, procedural-3d missing createProceduralPlayFixtureStore, s missing sPlayAppDefinition. Added static example JSON fallbacks for note/writer outside Vite. Removed stale `./playground` package.json exports from 23 core packages. createRuntime smoke test: 22/24 pass (trinity-jack/rewrite fail only in Node due to WASM).
